verses.en: Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?
verses.pt: Não sabeis vós, irmãos (pois estou falando com os que entendem a Lei), que a Lei domina o ser humano por todo o tempo que vive?
verses.en_web: Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?
verses.en_bbe: Is it not clear, my brothers (I am using an argument to those who have knowledge of the law), that the law has power over a man as long as he is living?

verses.en: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.
verses.pt: Pois a mulher casada está, pela Lei, ligada ao marido enquanto o ele viver; porém, depois do marido morrer, ela está livre da Lei do marido.
verses.en_web: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.
verses.en_bbe: For the woman who has a husband is placed by the law under the power of her husband as long as he is living; but if her husband is dead, she is free from the law of the husband.

verses.en: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.
verses.pt: Ou seja, enquanto o marido viver, ela será chamada de adúltera, se for de outro homem; mas depois de morto o marido, ela está livre da Lei, de maneira que não será adúltera se for de outro homem.
verses.en_web: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.
verses.en_bbe: So if, while the husband is living, she is joined to another man, she will get the name of one who is untrue to her husband: but if the husband is dead, she is free from the law, so that she is not untrue, even if she takes another man.

verses.en: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.
verses.pt: Assim, meus irmãos, também vós estais mortos para a Lei por meio do corpo de Cristo, para que sejais de outro, daquele que foi ressuscitado dos mortos, a fim de frutificarmos para Deus.
verses.en_web: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might produce fruit to God.
verses.en_bbe: In the same way, my brothers, you were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, so that you might be joined to another, even to him who came again from the dead, so that we might give fruit to God.

verses.en: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.
verses.pt: Pois, quando estávamos na carne, as paixões dos pecados, que eram pela Lei, operavam nos membros do nosso corpo, a fim de frutificarem para a morte.
verses.en_web: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law, worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.
verses.en_bbe: For when we were in the flesh, the evil passions which came into being through the law were working in our bodies to give the fruit of death.

verses.en: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.
verses.pt: Mas agora estamos livres da Lei, estando mortos para aquilo em que estávamos presos, para que sirvamos em novidade de espírito, e não na velhice da norma escrita.
verses.en_web: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.
verses.en_bbe: But now we are free from the law, having been made dead to that which had power over us; so that we are servants in the new way of the spirit, not in the old way of the letter.

verses.en: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.
verses.pt: Que diremos, pois? É a Lei pecado? De maneira nenhuma! Todavia, eu não teria conhecido o pecado, se não fosse pela Lei; porque não conheceria a cobiça, se a Lei não dissesse: Não cobiçarás. Êxodo 20:17; Deuteronômio 5:21
verses.en_web: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin, except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting, unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.”
verses.en_bbe: What then is to be said? is the law sin? in no way. But I would not have had knowledge of sin but for the law: for I would not have been conscious of desire if the law had not said, You may not have a desire for what is another's.

verses.en: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.
verses.pt: Mas o pecado, aproveitando-se do mandamento, operou em mim toda variedade de cobiça. Pois sem a Lei o pecado estaria morto.
verses.en_web: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.
verses.en_bbe: But sin, taking its chance through that which was ordered by the law, was working in me every form of desire: because without the law sin is dead.

verses.en: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
verses.pt: Antes eu vivia sem a Lei; mas quando veio o mandamento, o pecado reviveu, e eu morri;
verses.en_web: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
verses.en_bbe: And there was a time when I was living without the law: but when the law gave its orders, sin came to life and put me to death;

verses.en: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.
verses.pt: e descobri que o mandamento, que era para a vida, resultou-me para a morte.
verses.en_web: The commandment, which was for life, this I found to be for death;
verses.en_bbe: And I made the discovery that the law whose purpose was to give life had become a cause of death:

verses.en: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.
verses.pt: Pois o pecado, aproveitando o mandamento, me enganou, e por ele me matou.
verses.en_web: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.
verses.en_bbe: For I was tricked and put to death by sin, which took its chance through the law.

verses.en: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.
verses.pt: Portanto, a Lei é santa, e o mandamento é santo, justo, e bom.
verses.en_web: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
verses.en_bbe: But the law is holy, and its orders are holy, upright, and good.

verses.en: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.
verses.pt: Então o que é bom se tornou para mim morte? De maneira nenhuma! Mas foi o pecado, para que se mostrasse como pecado, que operou a morte em mim por meio do bem, a fim de que, por meio do mandamento, o pecado se tornasse excessivamente pecaminoso.
verses.en_web: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was producing death in me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceedingly sinful.
verses.en_bbe: Was then that which is good, death to me? In no way. But the purpose was that sin might be seen to be sin by working death to me through that which is good; so that through the orders of the law sin might seem much more evil.

verses.en: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.
verses.pt: Pois sabemos que a Lei é espiritual; mas eu sou carnal, vendido como servo do pecado.
verses.en_web: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.
verses.en_bbe: For we are conscious that the law is of the spirit; but I am of the flesh, given into the power of sin.

verses.en: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.
verses.pt: Porque não entendo o que faço, pois o que quero, isso não faço; mas o que eu odeio, isso faço.
verses.en_web: For I don’t know what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.
verses.en_bbe: And I have no clear knowledge of what I am doing, for that which I have a mind to do, I do not, but what I have hate for, that I do.

verses.en: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.
verses.pt: E se faço o que não quero, consinto que a Lei é boa;
verses.en_web: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.
verses.en_bbe: But, if I do that which I have no mind to do, I am in agreement with the law that the law is good.

verses.en: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
verses.pt: De maneira que agora não sou mais eu que faço aquilo, mas sim, o pecado que habita em mim.
verses.en_web: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
verses.en_bbe: So it is no longer I who do it, but the sin living in me.

verses.en: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.
verses.pt: Porque sei que em mim, isto é, em minha carne, não habita bem algum; porque o querer está em mim; porém o fazer o bem eu não consigo.
verses.en_web: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.
verses.en_bbe: For I am conscious that in me, that is, in my flesh, there is nothing good: I have the mind but not the power to do what is right.

verses.en: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.
verses.pt: Pois o bem que quero, não faço; mas o mal que não quero, isso faço.
verses.en_web: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.
verses.en_bbe: For the good which I have a mind to do, I do not: but the evil which I have no mind to do, that I do.

verses.en: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
verses.pt: Ora, se faço o que não quero, não sou eu que faço, mas sim, o pecado que habita em mim.
verses.en_web: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
verses.en_bbe: But if I do what I have no mind to do, it is no longer I who do it, but the sin living in me.

verses.en: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.
verses.pt: Acho, então, esta lei: que quando quero fazer o bem, o mal está comigo.
verses.en_web: I find then the law, that, to me, while I desire to do good, evil is present.
verses.en_bbe: So I see a law that, though I have a mind to do good, evil is present in me.

verses.en: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:
verses.pt: Pois, quanto ao ser interior, tenho prazer na Lei de Deus;
verses.en_web: For I delight in God’s law after the inward man,
verses.en_bbe: In my heart I take pleasure in the law of God,

verses.en: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.
verses.pt: mas em meus membros vejo outra lei, que batalha contra a lei do meu entendimento, e me prende sob a lei do pecado, que está nos meus membros.
verses.en_web: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.
verses.en_bbe: But I see another law in my body, working against the law of my mind, and making me the servant of the law of sin which is in my flesh.

verses.en: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
verses.pt: Miserável homem que sou! Quem me livrará deste corpo de morte?
verses.en_web: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?
verses.en_bbe: How unhappy am I! who will make me free from the body of this death?

verses.en: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.
verses.pt: Agradeço a Deus por Jesus Cristo, nosso Senhor. Assim, eu mesmo com o entendimento sirvo à Lei de Deus, mas, com a carne, à lei do pecado.
verses.en_web: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, the sin’s law.
verses.en_bbe: I give praise to God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So with my mind I am a servant to the law of God, but with my flesh to the law of sin.
